definitions.full: H2645. chaphah [ חָפָה ] verb cover (Late Hebrew id. , especially Pi`el; Aramaic חֲפָא , (especially Pa`el); Arabic be hidden , hide ) — Qal Perfect חָפוּ 2Sam 15:30 3 t.; Participle חָפוּי 15:30 ; construct חֲפוּי Est 6:12 ; — cover the head ( ראֹשׁ ), in token of grief 2Sam 15:30 ; Jer 14:3-4 , participle agrees with ׳ר 2Sam 15:30 ; ראֹשׁ חֲפוּי || (אָבֵלׅ Est 6:12 ; in token of sentence of death 7:8 . Niph`al Participle feminine נֶחְמָּה Psa 68:13 ( נ יונה ׳כנפי ), with בְּ of material. Pi`el Perfect (late) חִמָּה 2Che Psa 3:8 ; Psalm 3:9; Imperfect וַיְחַף 2Chr 3:7 ; suffix וַיְחַמֵּהוּ 3:5 , 8 ; overlay followed by 2 accusative (one of material) 3:5 (twice in verse); 3:7-8 , 9 .
